question: How many pedestrians were killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes each year from 2013 to 2025?

options.reason: Bars make the count for each individual year easy to compare.
options.interpretation: This directly answers how many pedestrians were killed in each calendar year, with each bar showing the annual total. A bar chart is defensible for comparing discrete yearly counts; it leaves within-year timing and causes of fatalities unanswered.

options.reason: A line emphasizes how annual pedestrian fatality counts change over time.
options.interpretation: This directly answers how many pedestrians were killed in each calendar year, while the connected points emphasize the sequence over time. A line chart is defensible for an ordered annual series; it leaves within-year timing and causes of fatalities unanswered.

answer:
The bar-chart framing shows 176 pedestrians killed in 2013, 133 in 2014, 133 in 2015, 149 in 2016, 127 in 2017, 123 in 2018, 131 in 2019, 101 in 2020, 132 in 2021, 135 in 2022, 107 in 2023, 124 in 2024, and 119 in 2025.
The line-chart framing shows the same annual totals: 176 in 2013, 133 in 2014, 133 in 2015, 149 in 2016, 127 in 2017, 123 in 2018, 131 in 2019, 101 in 2020, 132 in 2021, 135 in 2022, 107 in 2023, 124 in 2024, and 119 in 2025.
